solutions.title: History scan
solutions.strategy: Keep printed events and scan backward for a recent matching message.

timeComplexity.explanation: A call may scan all prior printed events.

solutions.title: Next allowed map
solutions.strategy: Map each message to the earliest timestamp where it can print again.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each call does constant map work.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The map stores one entry per message.
